## Result

- Skill: delivery-review.
- Review status: approved.
- Package members: registered primary plan path docs/plans/2026-09-10-release-validation-integration.md; exact revised subject recorded above.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r1, unchanged current approved Design package.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r2, round2.
- Traceability result: sufficient REL-SR-02/08/09/22–24 implementation and proof across both admitted CI paths.
- Material findings: no new findings; rvi-delivery-f1 resolved by original reporter.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful persistence.
- Open blockers: none for Delivery approval.
- Immediate next stage: return to route/plan for exact primary-subject registration and authorized execution; no work initialization or routing by reviewer.
- Claim limitations: planning adequacy only; no implemented correction, CI/Verify/PR or publication success.

## Independent reassessment

Original reporter read the complete revised plan. M1 step2 explicitly sends selected PR and direct main through common isolated preparation before their existing runners, retaining every direct main gate and order. The proof section now requires actual ci.sh --mode main on the same immutable base/head as PR plus direct dispatch/failure regressions, and explicitly forbids substituting selected-PR success. This completely addresses the identified allocation gap; no engineering change or waived check is inferred.

The same independent reviewer authored no plan, Design or engineering. R1 remains original with its changes-requested judgment; only its owned finding disposition is added. Current revised plan is read in full and its CLI-inspected identity is the basis of this new approval. The author is responsible for relinking the same registered primary-plan artifact to this approved identity before downstream reliance. No extra package member, new work initialization or reviewer-owned route mutation follows.

All unaffected analysis from r1 remains applicable: a bounded single M1 is feasible using the existing exact-source candidate builder and real package overlay; preserve original checkout and selected/direct checks, canonical/historical/incompatible tests and failure propagation; report changed proof subjects explicitly; never fabricate metadata or treat a premerge pass as publication authorization. The retained actual four-check red baseline and new stable major fixture must become real passing ordinary CI, not a receipt-only replacement for required CLI/npm suites.

The revised shared entry can be realized by composing existing coordinator and ci.sh facilities without another runner. Implementation review must establish that reentry or any context used to prevent recursion cannot bypass source/candidate identity checks or required preparation; the plan's mismatched-input rejection and preservation requirements already govern this. Main and PR now have explicit actual execution proof and existing dispatch/failure regression obligations. No direct gate, its order or historical command is waived merely because preparation performed some related checks first.

Final proof remains the same immutable source range for both modes, with captured actual checked source/package and unchanged original checkout. Model/prose/records checks complement behavioral proof. Independent M1 assessment and separate fresh final whole-change Code Review precede distinct Verify. Remote npm setup and the one release approval remain external prerequisites; zero provider PR approving reviews does not remove independent engineering assessment.

## Checks and handoff

Actually read complete revised plan, compared its exact correction to r1 finding and existing PR/main dispatch, refreshed primary context/subjects and recorded this judgment plus original-reporter resolution. No runtime experiment or engineering edit performed; proof remains implementation-owned. Scoped record validation and diff checks follow save. Return to author/route for primary artifact link and execution under this exact approved package.
independence_basis: Original independent nonauthor reread revised complete plan and assessed explicit main-path allocation; no authoring or routing edits.
